### Apple Skipping iPhone 18 This Year

Thursday July 30, 2026 6:31 am PDT by Joe Rossignol

Apple has no plans to release a standard iPhone 18 model this year, according to supply chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo and several other reputable sources. This September, Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and an all-new foldable iPhone that will reportedly be named the iPhone Ultra.
